slides.title: Stop putting things down 'for now.' Try the one-touch rule instead.
What it means
slides.body: When you pick something up, take it to its spot in one go. No 'for now' pit stop on the counter.

slides.title: Start with one category
slides.body: Try it only with mail, or only with cups. One habit at a time is plenty.

slides.title: Make the spot closer
slides.body: If the real home is too far, the rule breaks. Move the home closer to where you use it.

slides.title: Allow one 'later' basket
slides.body: Can't do it right now? One basket, not five surfaces. Empty it once a day.

slides.title: 'For now' is how a doom pile is born. One touch is how it stops.
Want more tiny rules like this?
slides.body: It's in The Messy Brain Home Reset, a 7-day shame-free ADHD home reset. Link in bio.
